name: slack
title: Slack
summary: Your own message, reaction, or mention in Slack starts a T3 thread about it.
day: A teammate reports a bug in a Slack thread. You react with :t3code:, and a thread starts to find the cause, with the whole Slack thread as its context.
cost: Your own Slack app, made from a manifest in a few minutes, and one small process that stays connected to Slack.
risk: Your Slack messages and the threads they belong to become agent prompts. Only your own messages, reactions, and mentions start a thread, and the prompt treats the rest of the Slack thread as data.

settings.question: What is your Slack member ID, so only your own messages start threads? In Slack, open your profile, then More, then Copy member ID.

workflows.name: Start a thread from Slack
workflows.sentence: Your own Slack message with :t3code:, your :t3code: reaction, or a mention of your Slack app starts a T3 thread, and Slack shows you its link.

moment.title: A thread from a Slack emoji
moment.body: A teammate reports a bug in Slack. You react with one emoji, and a thread starts to find the cause. Slack shows you its link a few seconds later.

workflows.risk: Your Slack messages and the threads they belong to become agent prompts. Only your own messages, reactions, and mentions start a thread.

human.say: Make your own Slack app for Start a thread from Slack, then paste its two tokens. Fleet keeps them in a file only you can read.

checks.say: The Slack app for Start a thread from Slack is not set up. Run fleet slack-trigger check to see why, and fleet slack-trigger setup to fix it.
